drchrono_new_appointment_trigger.description: Runs when an appointment is booked.

output.appointment: The record returned by the service

drchrono_new_message_trigger.description: Runs when a message arrives in the message center, such as a fax, lab result or patient message.

output.message: The record returned by the service

output.patient: The record returned by the service

drchrono_new_task_trigger.description: Runs when a task is created in the task center.

output.task: The record returned by the service

drchrono_patient_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a patient's details change.

output.patient: The record returned by the service

drchrono_task_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a task's status, assignee or details change.

output.task: The record returned by the service
